evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 法慧寺、宝相寺、谐奇趣
evidence.excerpt_zh: 海嶽開襟東北為諧竒趣東為法慧寺山門西嚮内為四面延樓後殿為光明性海其西别院有琉璃方塔法慧寺東為寳相寺山門南嚮内為澄光閣後為曇霏閣又後崇基上有殿為現大圓鏡（長春園册）臣等謹案法慧寺山門額曰普香界現大圓鏡殿内額曰香臺華鬘
evidence.summary: The only line in 日下舊聞考 on the European palaces: 諧竒趣 north-east of 海嶽開襟. Then 法慧寺 with a west-facing gate, 四面延樓, 光明性海 and a glazed square pagoda; 寳相寺 with a south-facing gate, 澄光閣, 曇霏閣 and 現大圓鏡 on a raised base.

evidence.title: Bourgeois on his set and on the colouring; Delatour on its arrival
evidence.excerpt_other: l'autre avoit commencé à mettre en couleur la première planche, mais il tomba malade et n'acheva pas. J'ai mis son esquisse, toute imparfaite qu'elle est, dans la caisse
evidence.summary: Two pupils of Castiglione got Bourgeois a set: one drew the general plan and positions of the buildings, the other began colouring the first plate. Delatour says the sending reached him at the end of 1787 and had certainly left Peking from 1785, against the holder's 'probably 1786'. E0462 has the first part of this passage; this adds the colouring.

evidence.title: Delatour's plates I, II, II suite
evidence.excerpt_other: Planche II. Suite. Elle représente le même palais esquissé pour les couleurs, mais il n'y en a qu'une petite partie sur la gauche dont l'enluminure soit assez terminée pour qu'on puisse distinguer les objets.
evidence.summary: Delatour's I is the sheet printed 二 (north, dolphin fountain); his II is the sheet printed 一 (south, double stair with the throne niche, pool, hemicycle galleries to octagonal pavilions, three-arch bridge). His own hand on the Rylands sheets says the same.

evidence.title: 谐奇趣
evidence.locator: v4 p.122, under 西洋楼; source ref 1-385
evidence.excerpt_zh: 运水由楼顶，发机务审详。周流虽尽妙，渗漏亦须防。波浪千层叠，珠玑万斛量。纡回伏脉远，灌注溯源长。浩浩终归壑，涓涓始滥觞。观澜奇趣会，至理即包藏。
evidence.summary: Poem 谐奇趣 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 西洋楼.

evidence.title: 观谐奇趣水法
evidence.locator: v4 p.121, under 西洋楼; source ref 1-110
evidence.excerpt_zh: 连延楼阁仿西洋，信是熙朝声教彰。激水引泉流荡漾，笵铜伏地制精良。惊潮翻石千夫御，白雨跳珠万斛量。巧擅人工思远服，版图式廓巩金汤。
evidence.summary: Poem 观谐奇趣水法 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 西洋楼.

evidence.title: Plate I: 谐奇趣 Xieqiqu, north front (by content)
evidence.locator: pp.173-175, Plate I
evidence.excerpt_other: Trois arcades au rez-de-chaussée; trois fenêtres à l'étage supérieur.
evidence.summary: Palace of two orders flanked by two isolated octagonal pavilions; the middle arch a niche with a throne; two-basin fountain with four dolphins and candelabra in a railed basin; lawns with shrubs and vases. Delatour's Plate I matches Malone's Engraving 2.

evidence.title: Plate II: 谐奇趣 Xieqiqu, south front (by content)
evidence.locator: pp.176-177, Plate II
evidence.excerpt_other: Sur le sol de cette seconde terrasse sont placées à droite et à gauche deux galeries en hémicycle, lesquelles ne s'élèvent que jusqu'au niveau de la première terrasse.
evidence.summary: Round stair with a double ramp and a niche with a throne; a basin with vases and animals, birds and quadrupeds spouting; a dolphin in the centre; octagonal pavilions at the ends of the galleries; on the left a triumphal arch with a European dial; a three-arch bridge. Delatour's Plate II matches Malone's Engraving 1.

evidence.title: 玉明 侍游御園記 (in 蕉軒隨錄)
evidence.locator: 蕉軒隨錄, 御園侍游 (line 336 of the corpus file)
evidence.excerpt_zh: ◎御园侍游玉将军（明）有《侍游御园记》，成竹坪同年（林）曾属予代作跋语，恭书于后。按，《记》云：“咸丰六年秋七月二十一日，奉旨：本日散朝后，著玉明、肃顺自备鞍马，午初一刻进西南门，在山高水长伺候。有顷，上从内乘船，至山高水长后阁扇下船，出前门，谕玉明、肃顺暨珠勒亨、西拉布、托云、德勒格尔、伊勒东阿等脱去外褂。上乘马，命七臣随行。自山高水长游藻园，至厂地，过汇芳书院，复由紫碧山房至鱼跃鸢飞少坐。过蕊珠宫门，至黄花磴进茶毕，往西洋楼海宴堂，至转马台，过小角门，至狮子林清淑斋赏饭。左右四卓，命七臣坐，并奉温谕可饱食，非外边筵宴比也。上命膳房先给七臣面各一器，上进面，复进饭，颁赏御用菜蔬，七臣叩头谢。上进粥，复赏粥毕。随驾起行，由宝相寺、法慧寺、谐奇趣过明春门，至雷峰夕照马头，坐如在天上船，游福海。上命笔砚作诗毕，至渊氵亭镜澈马头下船。进丽春门骑马，由旧园东墙根过敷春堂，游西大堤汉城关，至含辉楼下马，命七臣散归。玉明自道光十一年由侍卫擢厕御前二十余年，仰邀优渥，得遍瞻御园盛景。欣感之余，谨作记以纪荣遇。”
evidence.summary: A rare first-hand record of a day in the garden four years before its destruction. The emperor takes seven officials by a named route from 山高水長 through 藻園, 彚芳書院, 紫碧山房 and 魚躍鳶飛, past 蕊珠宫門, on to 海宴堂 in the 西洋樓, a meal at 清淑齋 in 獅子林, 寳相寺, 法慧寺, 諧奇趣, by boat on 福海, then 敷春堂 and 含暉楼. All were standing then.

evidence.title: The Official Map (S01) as Malone describes it
evidence.excerpt_other: The only serious mistake in the Official Map which the writer has found is in the location of the Hsieh Ch'i Ch'u, the first building in the foreign group, which is about two inches too far to the south.
evidence.summary: Bought from the draftsman Pai's family in Haidian; scale about 1 to 1300; every gate, wall, road, bridge, hill, canal and bay. Pasted sheets show alterations, as at scene 40. Later than the album. Purely a ground plan. Already used in Q3, Q5.

evidence.title: Engraving 1: 谐奇趣 Xieqiqu, south front
evidence.excerpt_other: A three-story building in the center was joined by curved galleries to two two-storied towers at the southeast and southwest of the main building.
evidence.summary: Curved stairs from the second floor down to a pool with several fountains between galleries and towers; a lake with a balustrade in front. Capitals mix Corinthian and Ionic (p.143).

evidence.title: Engraving 2: 谐奇趣 Xieqiqu, north front
evidence.excerpt_other: The north front of the Hsieh Ch'i Ch'u faced on a fantastically paved courtyard containing conventionally trimmed trees.
evidence.summary: North front on a patterned paved court with clipped trees. Plates p.142-143 show the ruin after 1860 (from Favier) and after further damage in 1900 and later.

evidence.title: Detail gain, 3 plates against the catalogue thumbs
evidence.locator: crops cmp08, cmp12, cmp15, cmp01 in palace_r6_tmp_plates
evidence.summary: Same regions at 900 px. Plate 8 (P0048): window lattice, shading hatch and baluster ornament resolve, thumb showed them as texture. Plate 12 (P0052): door panel pattern and urn outlines clear. Plate 15 (P0055): water drops and fountain tiers separate, thumb mashes them. Original is 2.6 times wider than the thumb. Plate 1 Chester Beatty against Palace Museum: 2.7 times wider again and far darker: roof tile, hatch and capitals sharp.

evidence.title: Van Braam, Dutch embassy, January-February 1795
evidence.excerpt_other: They are very numerous, of small dimensions, neatly furnished in the Chinese taste, and containing a few books and some very valuable curiosities. Three only of these apartments can boast of European time-pieces.
evidence.summary: Audience in a Tartar tent on the open space at the Drill Field; sled rides along frozen canals; goldfish of 15 inches and more; the emperor's rooms as quoted. They were not allowed to see the European buildings, and had seen twenty drawings of them in Canton. Told of a garden 300 li round with 36 residences; Malone calls this exaggerated.

evidence.title: Site status table, about 2011: remains tidied up
evidence.locator: 系列06 repost, status table
evidence.summary: A blogger's table of what was then visible. These scenes have building remains that have been cleared and tidied. Dated about 2011, so digs since then are not reflected.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 西洋楼
evidence.summary: The editors walk the strip from west to east with completion dates and plaques: 谐奇趣 1751, 养雀笼 1759, then the fountains and the perspective walls, with their mechanical details. They put the whole at about 2% of the gardens.

evidence.title: Ohlmer on 谐奇趣's colours, from his 1873 visit
evidence.locator: p.32, cited in Thiriez p.92, as quoted in S838
evidence.summary: A collector of Chinese ceramics who had photographed the ruin: the ornament had all colours of the rainbow, standing out against a white marble ground, reflected in the pool to the south. So the colour of 谐奇趣 was in strong coloured ornament on white marble, not on coloured walls. Excerpt left blank since the translation is modern: fetch the German.

evidence.title: Moore print of 谐奇趣 south across the pool, caption "Etat 1879 d'après Moore", Tessier & Sarrou, Paris, 17 Dec 2018, lot 2
evidence.locator: blog fig. 8; lot link https://www.tessier-sarrou.com/lot/93063/9677632
evidence.summary: The blog orders the south views of 谐奇趣: Ohlmer first, then Moore, then Child. Auction lot not opened.

evidence.title: 谐奇趣 floor plan, Yangshi Lei drawing 985 (Fig. 10)
evidence.locator: S108 p.78, Fig.10; 'Yangshi Lei drawing 985, National Library of China, Yangshi Lei Archive'
evidence.summary: The most annotated Lei plan known to the authors: over 120 dimensions where most carry up to 20. Its measures for the north stair differ from what they found on site, and traces of change suggest a working draft. They cross-check every Lei figure on the ground. Same sheet seen with shelf no. 样986 at 故宫 in S310 (E0935): see question.

evidence.locator: 故宫博物院图书馆 样985号
evidence.summary: Ink base plan of 谐奇趣 and its fountains. No. 985 at the Palace Museum library per S310; this is the number S108 cites as the sheet with over 120 dimensions, placing it at the National Library. No figures from it are public.

evidence.title: 谐奇趣样式雷图 (样986), 朱墨 底样, 设计与踏勘草图
evidence.locator: 故宫博物院图书馆 样986号
evidence.summary: Update to E0935: red lines mark three supply pipes from 蓄水楼 to 谐奇趣's pools; on the right, field notes of a two-storey elevation, a fountain, and a five-arch sluice elevation. Useful for the pipe run and the 线法桥 sluice.

evidence.title: Teng Gu's preface on the photographs and plan
evidence.locator: pp.3-5 of the preface, djvu pages 5-7
evidence.summary: Teng Gu says the photographs and the plan belonged to Ernst Boerschmann and were taken and drawn by Ohlmer, a customs official in Tianjin who lived in Beijing 1867-1879 and whose collection went to the Hildesheim museum. He argues they are earlier than those in Favier's Péking (1897), Combaz 1909, Perzynski 1920 and Münsterberg 1912, naming pages he compared. Fig. 13 is a recent photograph by Zhou Zuanwu; fig. 15 is copied from Favier p.264.

evidence.title: 西洋楼区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12205, free part
evidence.summary: Report's opening: the strip runs 860 m east-west, up to 300 m wide in the west and 65 m at its narrowest, about 70,000 m2, built 1747-1783. A central axis divides it into about five sections, each with its own north-south axis, thirteen units from 谐奇趣 to 线法墙. Survey results are paywalled.

evidence.title: Copper pipe dug up near 谐奇趣; red line on a 样式房 plan as water route
evidence.locator: lecture of 郭黛姮 as reported
evidence.summary: A Forbidden City 样式房 plan of 谐奇趣 has red lines, which she reads as water routes. Ground-penetrating radar found pipes, and a dig found a well-kept copper pipe. Schlimme's Benoist letter names a hydraulic-machine book whose figure matches the central axle visible through a half-open window on a plate. Independent backing for S600's Belidor.

facts.label: Note

Malone p.141: 3-storey centre, curved galleries to 2 two-storey towers SE and SW; S06 两层. Only XY building named in S05. Photos of ruins 1860+, 1900+ S02 p.142. Round 6 replaced frontage 39.7 m.
